title: President Trump Signs an Executive Order, Aug. 3, 2026
transcript: I have one question: how do I compare in terms of response with other presidents of the past?
shows: Trump at the Resolute Desk, turned around toward the military spouses standing behind him, mid-question, hand gesturing.

title: President Trump Signs an Executive Order, Aug. 3, 2026
shows: Wide shot of the Oval Office group behind the desk; the military spouse in the navy belted dress (standing closest to Trump) answers.

title: President Trump Signs an Executive Order, Aug. 3, 2026
transcript: Is it good or bad? No, it's good. Actually, it's very good.
shows: Trump pressing the question further from the Resolute Desk; the group of spouses and Defense Secretary Hegseth (blue tie, right side) listening and starting to smile.

title: President Trump Signs an Executive Order, Aug. 3, 2026
transcript: A little more than sleepy Joe? -- 100%.
shows: Trump turned toward the spouse again, needling with a grin; she answers back, visibly put on the spot in front of the group.

title: President Trump Signs an Executive Order, Aug. 3, 2026
shows: Silent cutaway: the spouses and Hegseth behind the desk breaking into smiles/suppressed laughter as the exchange plays out.

title: President Trump Signs an Executive Order, Aug. 3, 2026
shows: Silent cutaway: the spouse who answered laughs with her hand half-raised toward her face, visibly caught off guard, as others around her grin.
